Mockup, nothing is live yet

The other four baps.org finds

Each picture is the real website with the new part drawn in, inside a dashed gold line. Real photos and words from baps.org and pramukhswami.org are used wherever they have been read already.

Find 2. Through the years

Older years, from baps.org's daily darshan photo

Each day baps.org shows one darshan photo of Bapa with its month and place. Those photos add years before 1999 to Through the years: 1995, 1997 and 1998 so far, and more years as the reading carries on. Each one shows the month, place and Bapa's age, as below.

Find 3. Ask the diary

An essay answers when there are no photos

baps.org's English essays remember many days of Bapa's life. When you ask the diary about a day or place, the matching essay shows in the answer, and "Read the whole essay" opens it on our own site. The essays are read on Thursday or Friday, so this sample shows how it will look.

Find 4. Calendar

baps.org's picture of the month, beside the month name

baps.org makes one picture for every month from 2011. It sits on one side of the month name, with a photo of the other guru on the other side, so both gurus are always shown together.

Find 5. About

Bapa's life in pictures

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's life from 1940 to 2016, with pramukhswami.org's own photos and a short line for each year in English, with English dates only. Underneath is Mahant Swami Maharaj's row, made from the diary's own photos. Both rows scroll sideways.

What happens next
  1. Find 2 and find 5 use photos that have already been read. They can go live first, once the photos are copied into the website's photo store.
  2. Find 3 and find 4 go live as soon as the essays and month pictures are read, about Thursday or Friday.
  3. No source line goes on the website. The database keeps every caption, date, place and link.
